poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at one scheduled meeting. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on jobs data, inflation prints and officials' speeches.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: The Labor Department counted 29,000 new US jobs in September against 90,000 expected, and traders stopped paying for an October hike. Most Fed officials still expect another rise by year-end, but Waller said there is some flexibility on the timing, which keeps the hike alive and moves it past this meeting.

poly-nato-x-russia-military-clash-by-oct.standing: A contract that pays out if Russian and NATO forces clash directly before its deadline. The price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with incidents on the alliance's border and with Ukraine talks.
poly-nato-x-russia-military-clash-by-oct.recent: Nothing in the fortnight put Russian and NATO forces against each other: the strikes stayed between Russia and Ukraine, from Kramatorsk to Moscow. Washington instead threatened to halt the arms NATO allies buy for Kyiv under PURL, and each quiet day leaves less time before the deadline.

stocks:CVE.standing: A Calgary-based oil company and one of the largest producers in Canada's oil sands, with its own refineries in Canada and the United States. Its earnings turn on the discount heavy Canadian crude sells at against the US benchmark.
stocks:CVE.recent: Li Ka-shing's family sold a British grid for HK$110 billion and bought into Canadian oil sands, a swap that came after the share had already slid. Nothing in it accounts for the fall.

stocks:0001.HK.standing: A Hong Kong conglomerate built by Li Ka-shing, with ports, retail chains, telecoms networks and infrastructure across some 50 countries. Most of its earnings come from outside Hong Kong, so it trades on global trade and deal-making.
stocks:0001.HK.recent: Li Ka-shing's family sold a British grid for HK$110 billion, moving money out of regulated power networks. The sale was reported after the stretch the chart covers, and nothing in it accounts for the share price.

stocks:0700.HK.standing: The Shenzhen company behind WeChat, the app most of China uses to message and pay, and the world's largest video-game publisher by revenue. Its Hong Kong share is one of the heaviest weights in the Hang Seng index.

stocks:BABA.standing: China's largest e-commerce company, owner of the Taobao and Tmall marketplaces and of the country's biggest cloud business. Its New York-listed share is the one most foreign investors use to take a view on Chinese consumers and tech.
stocks:BABA.recent: Alibaba sued the Pentagon in Washington over its classification as a Chinese military affiliate, denying any link to the Chinese military; the share's trough came as the suit was reported. Earlier, China blocked Hugging Face a year after Alibaba's rival hub launched, clearing the home field for it.

poly-will-missouri-enact-a-data-center-m.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Missouri enacts a moratorium on new data centers before 2027. It prices how far a state will go to slow an industry whose power and water demand lands on local grids and ratepayers.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-united-serbia.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Serbian Progressive Party of President Aleksandar Vučić wins the most seats in Serbia's next parliamentary election. The party has led every government since 2012.

poly-2026-balance-of-power-r-senate-d-ho.standing: A contract that pays out if Republicans hold the US Senate and Democrats win the House in the 2026 midterms. A split Congress can block the president's bills from the House while the Senate keeps confirming nominees.

poly-will-texas-enact-a-data-center-mora.standing: What traders will pay for a bet that Texas halts new data center construction by law. The state runs its own power grid and is one of the largest US data center markets, so a pause there would reach the AI buildout.

poly-will-the-republicans-win-the-texas-.standing: What traders pay for a contract that settles at 100 if a Republican wins Texas's 2026 US Senate election. No Democrat has won statewide office in Texas since 1994, so the seat is one Republicans count on to hold the chamber.

poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz returns to its usual level by the deadline. About a fifth of the world's oil sails through the strait, so this is a bet on that supply.
poly-strait-of-hormuz-traffic-returns-to.recent: Traders sold after Iran's Guards claimed mine strikes on two supertankers and Tehran called Washington's reply to its seven conditions for reopening the strait insufficient. Mediation had already deadlocked, and Kpler put oil exports 42% below prewar levels. A US jet also disabled a Panama-flagged tanker running the blockade.

poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a ceasefire before the stated deadline. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, strikes and each side's stated terms.
poly-russia-x-ukraine-ceasefire-agreemen.recent: Putin ruled out a ceasefire on long-range strikes, and nothing since has moved the bet back. Trump announced an energy truce that a State Duma energy committee member said he knew nothing about, and Zelensky says Russia hit Kharkiv's power plant after it. Washington's talks in Miami included Ukraine and Europe, without Russia.

poly-will-louisiana-enact-a-data-center-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Louisiana enacts a statewide ban or moratorium on new data centers before its deadline. The state hosts Meta's largest planned AI campus, whose power demand is being met with new gas plants.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the largest seller of rented computing power. The cloud arm earns most of the profit, so the share moves on data-centre demand more than on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: Amazon built its 1,000th satellite and is weeks away from the rollout of Leo, its space internet service. It also launched new Kindles ahead of Prime Big Deal Days and Alexa tablets that drop the Fire branding, then shuffled Alexa leadership. None of these is a results event, and nothing here accounts for the share price on its own.

poly-will-jeremiah-smith-win-the-2026-he.standing: A contract that pays out if Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith wins the Heisman Trophy, college football's top individual award. Sportswriters and past winners vote, and they usually pick a quarterback.

poly-gemini-4pt0-released-by-october-14-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Google releases its Gemini 4.0 AI model by the deadline in the question. The price is what traders pay for a yes share, and it moves on leaks, launch schedules and rival labs' releases.

poly-will-north-carolina-enact-a-data-ce.standing: What traders will pay for a bet that North Carolina halts new data center construction before the contract's deadline. The state is a major data center host, and the fight is over who pays for the power they draw.

stocks:EBAY.standing: An online marketplace where individuals and businesses sell new and used goods by auction or at a fixed price. It holds no stock itself and earns fees on each sale, so its revenue follows how much consumers spend through it.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-us-presi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if JD Vance wins the 2028 US presidential election. The price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves with his standing as vice-president and presumed Republican heir.

poly-will-the-republican-party-control-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Republicans hold a majority of the US House after the 2026 midterms. The House majority decides which bills reach a vote and who runs investigations of the president.

poly-will-aleksandar-vucic-be-the-next-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Aleksandar Vučić becomes Serbia's next prime minister. He has run the country as prime minister and then president, and the constitution bars him from a third presidential term.

stocks:AIR.PA.standing: Europe's largest aerospace company and one of the two builders of large passenger jets, with defence, helicopter and space arms. Its share moves on how many aircraft it delivers against a backlog that runs years ahead.
stocks:AIR.PA.recent: The news was all from the defence and space side: ESA picked the company and OHB to study a European-led space station, Spain chose an A321 as its new electronic intelligence aircraft, and the U740 Valkyrie drone flew at Mach 0.8. None of it touches the passenger-jet business, and none accounts for the slide.

poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-secon.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Flávio Bolsonaro wins Brazil's presidential election by a margin of four to eight percentage points. It prices how close the race is, not just who wins.
poly-will-flavio-bolsonaro-win-the-secon.recent: Brazil voted for a president, governors and lawmakers on 4 October and the presidential race went to a runoff, with Bolsonaro's strong showing leaving the left on the ropes. That first round set the margin traders are betting on; nothing reported since explains why this band gained.

stocks:KTOS.standing: A San Diego defense contractor that builds jet-powered target drones and low-cost uncrewed combat aircraft, among them the XQ-58A Valkyrie. Its revenue depends on how far the Pentagon commits to cheap, expendable aircraft.
stocks:KTOS.recent: Airbus says its U740, the European variant of the XQ-58A Valkyrie, has flown at Mach 0.8 in Northern Europe. That is a step forward for the drone Kratos designed, and it does not account for the fall in the share.
